configsection.name: listeners
configsection.configdescription:
Each entry is the fully-qualified name of a class that Satisfiend should register against the horde-wide PSR-14 listener provider at bootstrap. Every entry must:
- be autoloadable (add a PSR-4 mapping to the root bundle's composer.json, then run composer dump-autoload); - be constructible via the Horde injector (constructor arguments, if any, are resolved from the container - Horde\Db\Adapter, Psr\Log\LoggerInterface, and other bound services are all available); - be callable, typically by defining __invoke(\Horde\Satisfiend\Event\WebhookReceivedEvent $event): void.
Satisfiend's own PersistEventListener is always registered separately; entries here are strictly additive. A misconfigured class is logged and skipped; it does not take the webhook receiver down.
See doc/WEBHOOK.md for a complete example.
